checks.title: House bankroll
checks.text: Treasury stablecoins are +5.8% over 30 days, at $2.45M. Watch below −5%, alert below −15%. Betting-pool capital joins this check from 21 Dec 2026, after 30 days of onchain readings.
checks.why: The treasury backs every bet. If its money shrinks, losses or spending are outrunning what the house wins.

checks.title: House result trend
checks.text: DefiLlama switched from counting fees to the full betting result on 21 Jul 2026, so earlier periods aren’t comparable. Like-for-like 90-day comparisons start 17 Jan 2027. The 90 days to 20 Nov 2026 brought in $650K.
checks.why: Buybacks only last if the house keeps winning, so this compares its latest 90 days with the 90 before.

checks.title: Buyback cover
checks.text: The house result covered buybacks 3.1× over the 90 days to 20 Nov 2026: $650K against $209K. It was 2.9× over 30 days and 2.1× over 7 days. Since 21 Jul 2026, 3 of 17 weeks didn’t cover their buybacks, but no 90-day stretch dropped below 3.0×. Healthy from 1.5×, alert below 1×.
checks.why: Buybacks should be paid for by what the house wins, not by drawing down the treasury.

checks.title: Buyback rate
checks.text: Buybacks averaged $2.3K a day in the 7 days to 20 Nov 2026, against $2.3K in the 30 days before (−0.8%). Watch below −20%, alert below −50%.
checks.why: Buybacks are how holders get paid. A cut is the clearest sign that payout is shrinking.

checks.title: House OVER
checks.text: The house holds 19.5M OVER: 15.7M in treasury wallets, 2.12M in Overtime’s admin multisigs and 1.69M in the OVER betting pools and open bets. Daily readings started 21 Nov 2026; the first change shows with the second one.
checks.why: Overtime holds a large block of OVER, across its treasury, admin multisigs and betting pools. If it sells, that supply lands on the market.
